senses.gloss:
शृङ्खल शृङ्खल, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. (ety-
mology doubtful; perhaps connected with शिञ्जा, ‘a
tinkling sound’), an iron chain; any chain or fetter;
a belt or chain worn round the waist for ornament,
&c.; an iron chain for confining the feet of an
elephant; a measuring chain.
—शृङ्खल-ता, f. or
शृङ्खल-त्व, अम्, n. the being chained together;
restraint; concatenation, connection, order; a series.
—शृङ्खला-बन्ध or शृङ्खला-बन्धन,
अम्, n. confining by chains or fetters.

शृङ्खलक, अस्, m. a chain; a young camel or
other young animal with wooden rings or clogs on
his feet (to prevent his straying); any camel.

शृङ्खलित, अस्, आ, अम्, chained, fettered, bound,
confined.
शृङ्खली, f. a kind of plant (= कोकिलाक्ष).

शृङ्ग शृङ्ग, अम्, n. (according to Uṇādi-s.
I. 125. fr. rt. शॄ with affix ग, a nasal being inserted;
according to some perhaps contracted fr. शिरङ्-ग,
‘head-going’), a horn; the top or summit of a
mountain, a peak, crag; the summit of a building,
pinnacle, turret; any peak or point or projection or
lofty object; a cusp or horn of the moon; height,
elevation, dignity, lordship, mastership, supremacy,
sovereignty; the rising or bursting forth of desire,
excess of love or passion; anything sharp or fine-
pointed; a fountain or artificial spout of water; any
horn-like vessel or instrument; a buffalo's horn or
other horn used for blowing; a lotus; a mark, token,
sign; (अस्), m. a medicinal plant and root (= जी-
वक); N. of a Ṛṣi or Muni (of whom, in some
parts of India, on occasions of drought, earthen
images are said to be made and supplicated for rain);
[cf. Gr. κέρας; Lat. cornu; Goth. haurn; Angl.
Sax. horn.]
—शृङ्ग-कन्द, अस्, m. a kind of
plant (= शृङ्गाटक).
—शृङ्ग-गिरि, इस्, m., N.
of a mountain.
—शृङ्ग-ग्राहिका, f. (in logic) dis-
tribution, taking singly and severally all the parti-
[]
culars included under a general term or all the indi-
viduals composing a body.
—शृङ्ग-ज, अस्, आ, अम्,
horn-produced, made from horn; produced on
mountain-peaks; (अस्), m. an arrow, shaft; (अम्), n.
the aloe wood or tree (= अ-गुरु).
—शृङ्ग-पुर,
अम्, n., N. of a town.
—शृङ्ग-प्रहारिन्, ई, इणी,
इ, horn-striking, butting or fighting with the horns.
—शृङ्ग-प्रिय, अस्, m. epithet of Śiva.
—शृङ्ग-
मूल, अस्, m. a kind of plant (= शृङ्गाटक).
—शृङ्ग-मोहिन्, ई, m. the Campaka tree.
—शृङ्ग-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having peaks, peaked;
(आन्), m. a mountain; epithet of a mythical moun-
tain forming one of the boundaries of the earth.
—शृङ्ग-वृष्, ट्, m., Ved. epithet of the Sun;
N. of a Ṛṣi (said to have been the father of Indra;
शृङ्ग-वृषो नपात्, the offspring of Śṛṅga-vṛṣ,
i. e. Indra).
—शृङ्ग-वेर, अम्, n. ginger (undried
or dry); N. of a town (= गुह-चण्डाल-पुर).
—शृङ्ग-वेरक, अम्, n. ginger.
—शृङ्गवेरा-
भ-मूलक (˚र-आभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘having a root
like that of ginger,’ a kind of grass (= एरका).
—शृङ्ग-शत, अम्, n. a hundred peaks.
—शृङ्-
गाग्र-प्रहरणाभिमुख (˚ग-अग्˚, ˚ण-अभ्˚),
अस्, ई, अम्, advancing towards or making a charge
with the weapons of the points of the horns; ready
to strike with the points of the horns.
—शृङ्गान्-
तर (˚ग-अन्˚), अम्, n. the space or interval be-
tween the horns (of a cow &c.).
—शृङ्गीश्वर-
तीर्थ (˚गी-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—शृङ्गोच्-
छ्राय (˚ग-उच्˚), अस्, m. a lofty peak.
—शृङ्गोन्-
नति (˚ग-उन्˚), इस्, f. elevation of a horn, the rising
(of the moon?; cf. शीर्षोदय).

शृङ्गक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a horn; anything
pointed; a cusp or horn of the moon; (अस्), m. a
medicinal root, (commonly called Jīvaka.)

शृङ्गला, f. a particular plant (= अज-शृङ्गी,
‘goat's horn’).

शृङ्गाटक, अम्, n. a place where four roads
meet; a kind of pastry or dish of minced meat, &c.
(called Samūsā in Hindī); a door; (अस्), m. the
aquatic plant Trapa Bispinosa; a mountain having
three peaks.

शृङ्गार, अस्, m. (probably connected with शृङ्ग
in the sense of ‘rising of desire;’ according to
Uṇādi-s. III. 136. fr. rt. शॄ with affix आर, a nasal
and ग् being inserted), love, sexual passion, erotic sen-
timent; sexual union, coition; a dress suitable for
amorous purposes, an elegant dress; a mark or marks
with red-lead on an elephant's head and trunk by
way of ornament; any mark; N. of the father of
Jaya-ratha; (अम्), n. cloves; red-lead; fragrant
powder for the dress or person; undried ginger;
Agallochum.
—शृङ्गार-चेष्टा, f. love-gesture, any
outward action indicating love.
—शृङ्गार-तिलक,
अम्, n., N. of an erotic poem by Rudra-bhaṭṭa.
—शृङ्गार-भाषित, अम्, n. a love story.
—शृङ्-
गार-भूषण, अम्, n. red-lead.
—शृङ्गार-
मण्डप, N. of a temple.
—शृङ्गार-योनि, इस्,
m. ‘love-source,’ epithet of Kāma, god of love.
—शृङ्गार-रस, अस्, m. the erotic sentiment.
—शृङ्गाररसाष्टक (˚स-अष्˚), अम्, n., N. of
eight stanzas by Kālidāsa on the erotic sentiment.
—शृङ्गार-वती, f., N. of a town; of a queen.
—शृङ्गार-विधि, इस्, m. a dress suitable for
amorous interviews.
—शृङ्गार-वेश, अस्, आ, अम्,
dressed suitably for amorous enterprises.
—शृङ्गार-
शत or शृङ्गार-शतक, अम्, n. ‘a hundred verses
on love,’ N. of the second book of Bhartṛ-hari's
poem.
—शृङ्गार-सहाय, अस्, m. an assistant in
affairs of love, confidant of a dramatic hero.
—शृङ्-
गारैक-रस (˚र-एक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, whose sole
feeling is love.

शृङ्गारक, अस्, आ, अम्, horned, having a horn
or crest; (अस्), m. love, &c. = शृङ्गार; (अम्), n.
red-lead.

शृङ्गारित, अस्, आ, अम्, affected by love, impas-
sioned; stained with red-lead, reddened; adorned,
decorated, embellished.

शृङ्गि, इस्, f. a species of Silurus or sheat-fish;
(इस्), m. gold for ornaments, (said to be also शृङ्गि,
n.; cf. शृङ्गी.)
—शृङ्गि-कनक, अम्, n. gold used
for ornaments.

शृङ्गी, f. a kind of gold used for making orna-
ments; a sort of Silurus or sheat-fish; a particular
medicinal root shaped like a bull's horn (= ऋष-
भ); a kind of poison; a kind of Betula; N. of
various other plants and trees (= अति-विषा; = कर्-
कट-शृङ्गी; = प्लक्ष; = वट).
—शृङ्गी-क-
नक, अम्, n. a kind of gold used for ornaments.

शृङ्गिक, अम्, n. a sort of poison; (आ), f. a kind
of Betula or birch tree (= प्रति-विषा).
शृङ्गिण, अस्, आ, अम्, horned; (अस्), m. a ram.

शृङ्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, horned; crested, peaked; (ई),
m. a mountain; N. of a mythical mountain forming
one of the boundaries of the earth, (Viṣṇu-Purāṇa
II. 2); an elephant; a tree; N. of a son of Gautama;
epithet of Śiva; (इणी), f. a cow; Arabian jasmine or
another species; heart-pea; the plant Kaṭukī.
शृङ्गेरि-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
शृङ्गेरी-मठ, N. of a place.

सृङ्का सृङ्का, f. a kind of garland made of
jewels.
